integrity: Analytic proof with root and monotonicity derivation; reproducible independent finite-state rational checker. Finite tests are nonexhaustive corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous cycle with n>=3, clockwise p>q>0, one reset destination and exponential reset times. Only microscopic hopping-edge currents; not conserved total currents with reset trajectories. No inhomogeneous or interacting extensions. No independent audit or publication-priority certification.
title: An ordered cascade of edge-current reversals on a point-reset biased Markov ring
